results.title: SwagUp Reviews, Pricing & Features (2026) | SalesHive
results.snippet: Key SwagUp features include a swag pack builder with free in-house design, centralized inventory management and warehousing, global fulfillment, Redeem Pages for collecting recipient info and triggering shipments, SwagUp Shops for credit-based swag stores, and a modern dashboard to manage orders and tracking. SwagUp also supports third-party item storage, offers tiered memberships with discounts and rewards, and provides extensive integrations - native HRIS connectors plus Zapier and an open API - for automating swag around events like onboarding, anniversaries, and campaign milestones.

results.snippet: The main limitation is cost at scale: warehousing fees, per-item storage charges, shipping costs, and an 8% shop transaction fee stack up quickly, making it a harder fit for high-volume programs on tighter budgets.
